data.name: CreatorIntro_Aria
data.value: A message from the creator of GPlanner

data.name: CreatorIntro_P1
data.value: I built GPlanner as the app I wanted to use myself at every workout.

data.name: CreatorIntro_P2
data.value: No noise. Just workouts, progress and tools that actually help in the gym.

data.name: CreatorIntro_P3
data.value: I have trained in the gym for years, and that experience is largely why GPlanner exists.

data.name: CreatorIntro_P4
data.value: But this app is not here to teach you how to train or to push particular programmes, techniques or methods on you.

data.name: CreatorIntro_P6
data.value: Over the years I have seen how different people's goals, habits and approaches to training can be. So I wanted a tool that feels comfortable whatever your experience and whatever approach you take — whether you are new to it or have trained for years.

data.name: CreatorIntro_P7
data.value: Everyone has their own path, their own goals and their own idea of what training means.

data.name: CreatorIntro_P8
data.value: GPlanner is not meant to change any of that or tell you how to train — it is meant to give you convenient tools so you can train the way that suits you.

data.name: CreatorIntro_P9
data.value: At the same time, I do not want GPlanner to grow only on my own ideas.

data.name: CreatorIntro_P10
data.value: If something is missing, something could be handier, or you have an idea for a new feature — tell me about it.

data.name: CreatorIntro_P11
data.value: I will read your suggestions, think them over and, if they genuinely make the app better, bring them into GPlanner step by step.

data.name: CreatorIntro_P12
data.value: I want the app to get better over time together with the people who use it.

data.name: CreatorIntro_P13
data.value: Because in the end GPlanner is built for people who actually train.

data.name: Help_Today_S3_Step1
data.value: Find the set row: its number, the kg field and the reps field.

data.name: Help_Today_S3_Step2
data.value: If what you actually lifted differs from the plan, correct it right in those fields.

data.name: Help_Today_S3_Step3
data.value: Tap the check mark on the right of the row to mark the set done.

data.name: Help_Today_S3_Step4
data.value: At the bottom of the card use Exercise rating to record how hard it felt.

data.name: Help_Today_S4_Step1
data.value: Tap the Rest between sets chip under the set you have just finished.

data.name: Help_Today_S4_Step2
data.value: Change the number in the Rest time field if you need to.

data.name: Help_Today_S4_Step3
data.value: Tap Start, then Done. The countdown keeps running after the dialog closes.

data.name: Help_Today_S5_Title
data.value: Switch between a warm-up and a working set

data.name: Help_Today_S5_Text
data.value: Warm-up sets are not counted as working sets when the app measures your load.

data.name: Help_Today_S5_Step1
data.value: Tap the set number on the left of the row.

data.name: Help_Today_S5_Step2
data.value: The number changes colour as the set switches between warm-up and working.

data.name: Help_Today_S6_Text
data.value: Card actions are hidden behind a long press so they stay out of your way mid-workout.

data.name: Help_Today_S6_Step1
data.value: Press and hold the header of the exercise card.

data.name: Help_Today_S6_Step2
data.value: In the dialog choose Edit the workout, Add a photo or Delete the card.

data.name: Help_Today_S7_Text
data.value: Finishing moves the result into History. The button works on a long press so it cannot be hit by accident.

data.name: Help_Today_S7_Step1
data.value: Press and hold Finish the workout at the bottom of the page until the ring closes.

data.name: Help_Today_S7_Step2
data.value: After a free workout, answer the question about turning it into a template.

data.name: Help_Today_S7_Step3
data.value: The saved result then appears in the History tab.

data.name: Help_Workouts_S1_Step1
data.value: Tap Add a template at the bottom of the list.

data.name: Help_Workouts_S1_Step2
data.value: Type a name into the Name field.

data.name: Help_Workouts_S1_Step3
data.value: Tap Save and the template appears in the list.

data.name: Help_Workouts_S2_Step1
data.value: Tap the template card in the list.

data.name: Help_Workouts_S2_Step2
data.value: Add the exercises on the page that opens.

data.name: Help_Workouts_S2_Step3
data.value: Go back with the To the templates button.

data.name: Help_Workouts_S3_Step1
data.value: Tap the settings button on the template card.

data.name: Help_Workouts_S3_Step3
data.value: Enter the new name and tap Save.

data.name: Help_Workouts_S4_Step1
data.value: Tap the settings button on the template card.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_Intro
data.value: This is where the workout is composed: which exercises it contains, how many sets and at what weight.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S1_Text
data.value: The exercise comes from the library, and its sets are defined as you add it.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S1_Step1
data.value: Tap Add an exercise at the top of the page.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S1_Step2
data.value: Pick the one you need in the Exercise from the library field.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S1_Step3
data.value: Set the Number of sets and the set rows appear below.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S1_Step4
data.value: Fill in Weight and Repetitions for every set, then tap Save.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S2_Text
data.value: Exercise actions open with a long press on its card.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S2_Step1
data.value: Press and hold the exercise card.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S2_Step2
data.value: In Manage the exercise choose Edit the parameters or Delete the exercise.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S3_Text
data.value: Warm-up sets are labelled separately and are not counted as working sets.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S3_Step1
data.value: Tap the set number in the row.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S3_Step2
data.value: The label next to it switches between warm-up and working.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S4_Text
data.value: A photo helps you recall the technique or the machine settings before a set.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S4_Step1
data.value: Tap the photo chip on the exercise card.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S4_Step2
data.value: Choose a picture from your library or take a new one with the camera.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S5_Text
data.value: A superset joins two exercises that are performed back to back with no rest in between.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S5_Step1
data.value: Tap Create a superset at the top of the page.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S5_Step2
data.value: Select two exercises from the list.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetails_S5_Step3
data.value: Confirm, and the exercises merge into a single card.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetailsWeb_S1_Text
data.value: An exercise can come from the library or be given a name of your own.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetailsWeb_S1_Step1
data.value: Click Add an exercise at the top of the page.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetailsWeb_S1_Step2
data.value: Choose an option in Exercise from the library, or type your own into the Name field.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetailsWeb_S1_Step3
data.value: Set the Number of sets and the weight fields appear below.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetailsWeb_S1_Step4
data.value: Fill in the weight for each set and click Add.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetailsWeb_S2_Text
data.value: Exercise actions live in the menu on its card.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetailsWeb_S2_Step1
data.value: Click the menu button in the top right corner of the exercise card.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetailsWeb_S2_Step2
data.value: In Manage the exercise choose Edit the parameters or Delete the exercise.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetailsWeb_S3_Text
data.value: A photo helps you recall the technique or the machine settings before a set.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetailsWeb_S3_Step1
data.value: Click the add-photo chip on the exercise card.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetailsWeb_S3_Step2
data.value: Pick a file; the picture uploads and shows up on the card.

data.name: Help_WorkoutDetailsWeb_S3_Step3
data.value: Click the photo to open it full screen.

data.name: Help_Calendar_S1_Step1
data.value: Use the arrows beside the month name to reach the month you need.

data.name: Help_Calendar_S1_Step2
data.value: Tap a day in the grid to open the Selected day dialog.

data.name: Help_Calendar_S1_Step3
data.value: Pick a template in the Assign a workout list.

data.name: Help_Calendar_S2_Step1
data.value: Tap a day that already has a workout on it.

data.name: Help_Calendar_S2_Step3
data.value: Pick the new date in the date picker that opens.

data.name: Help_Calendar_S3_Step1
data.value: Tap the day with the scheduled workout.

data.name: Help_Calendar_S3_Step2
data.value: Tap Delete in the actions dialog.

data.name: Help_Calendar_S4_Text
data.value: The calendar refuses to schedule in two situations, and neither is an error.

data.name: Help_Calendar_S4_Step1
data.value: On a past day you will see a note saying the day is in the past.

data.name: Help_Calendar_S4_Step2
data.value: On today while a free workout is running: finish or delete that workout first.

data.name: Help_CalendarWeb_Intro
data.value: The calendar shows which days have workouts and opens a day dialog when you click a date.

data.name: Help_CalendarWeb_S1_Step1
data.value: Use the arrows beside the month name to reach the month you need.

data.name: Help_CalendarWeb_S1_Step2
data.value: Click a day in the grid to open its dialog.

data.name: Help_CalendarWeb_S1_Step3
data.value: Click Assign a workout and choose a template from the list.

data.name: Help_CalendarWeb_S2_Step1
data.value: Click the day with the scheduled workout.

data.name: Help_CalendarWeb_S2_Step2
data.value: Click the delete button in the day dialog.

data.name: Help_CalendarWeb_S3_Step1
data.value: No workout assigned means nothing is planned for that day.

data.name: Help_CalendarWeb_S3_Step2
data.value: A past-day notice means you cannot schedule retroactively.

data.name: Help_History_S1_Step1
data.value: Tap the workout card in the list.

data.name: Help_History_S1_Step2
data.value: In the dialog review the exercises, sets, weights and repetitions.

data.name: Help_History_S1_Step3
data.value: The marks beside each set show which ones were completed.

data.name: Help_History_S2_Step2
data.value: Next to each set number you will see whether it was a warm-up or a working set.

data.name: Help_History_S3_Step1
data.value: Open the entry and choose Delete the entry.

data.name: Help_Progress_S1_Step1
data.value: Open Exercises to see the trend for a single exercise.

data.name: Help_Progress_S1_Step2
data.value: Open Workouts to see the trend for a whole workout.

data.name: Help_Progress_S2_Step1
data.value: Finish at least one workout on the Today page.

data.name: Help_Progress_S2_Step2
data.value: Come back to Progress; the data shows up once a workout is finished.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercises_Intro
data.value: Shows how your result in one exercise changed relative to the first workout that contained it.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercises_S1_Text
data.value: The chart opens in landscape; the screen rotates on its own, so there is no need to turn the phone.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercises_S1_Step1
data.value: Find the exercise in the list; the template it belongs to is named underneath.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercises_S1_Step2
data.value: Tap the card to open the chart for the last 30 days.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercises_S1_Step3
data.value: Close the dialog to go back; the orientation returns with it.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercises_S2_Text
data.value: The line shows change relative to the first workout, not the absolute weight.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercises_S2_Step1
data.value: Below the chart check Growth, Best result and the workout count.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercises_S2_Step2
data.value: Expand Show exact values to see the numbers by date.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercises_S3_Text
data.value: Only the progress is reset; the finished-workout history is left untouched.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercises_S3_Step1
data.value: Tap the menu button on the exercise card.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercises_S3_Step2
data.value: Confirm the reset in the dialog that opens.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercisesWeb_S1_Text
data.value: On the web the exercises are grouped by workout, so you open the workout first and the exercise second.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercisesWeb_S1_Step1
data.value: Click a workout card to open the list of its exercises.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercisesWeb_S1_Step2
data.value: Click the exercise name in that list.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercisesWeb_S1_Step3
data.value: The chart for the last 30 days opens.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercisesWeb_S3_Step1
data.value: In the exercise list click the menu button next to the one you want.

data.name: Help_ProgressExercisesWeb_S3_Step2
data.value: Confirm the reset in the dialog that opens.

data.value: Open the workout card in the list.

data.name: Help_ProgressWorkouts_S1_Step2

data.name: Help_ProgressWorkouts_S2_Step1
data.value: Below the chart check Growth, Best result and the workout count.

data.name: Help_ProgressWorkouts_S2_Step2
data.value: Expand Show exact values to see the numbers by date.

data.name: Help_ProgressWorkouts_S3_Text
data.value: Only the progress is reset; the finished-workout history is left untouched.

data.name: Help_ProgressWorkouts_S3_Step1
data.value: Open the menu button on the workout card.

data.name: Help_ProgressWorkouts_S3_Step3
data.value: Confirm in the dialog that opens.

data.name: Help_Profile_S1_Step2
data.value: Change your first name, last name, date of birth or gender.

data.name: Help_Profile_S2_Step2
data.value: Fill in the between-sets and between-exercises values.

data.value: The report goes straight to the developer. Never include passwords or one-time codes.

data.name: Help_Profile_S4_Step2
data.value: Describe what happened in the What happened field.

data.name: Help_Profile_S4_Step3
data.value: Attach a screenshot if it helps.
